questions.description: 闭包实现 LRU 缓存雏形。
questions.code_template:
def make_lru(capacity):
    cache = {}
    order = []
    def get(k):
        if k in cache:
            order.remove(k)
            order.append(k)
            return cache[k]
        return None
    def put(k, v):
        if k in cache:
            order.remove(k)
        elif len(order) >= capacity:
            oldest = order.pop(0)
            del cache[oldest]
        cache[k] = v
        order.append(k)
    return get, put

get, put = make_lru(2)
put("a", 1)
put("b", 2)
put("c", 3)
print(get("a"))
print(___)
questions.solution:

questions.description: 综合：作用域与闭包完整演示。
questions.code_template:
def make_processor():
    data = []
    total = 0
    def add(n):
        nonlocal total
        data.append(n)
        total += n
        return total
    def summary():
        return len(data), total, total / len(data)
    return add, summary

add_item, get_summary = make_processor()
add_item(10)
add_item(20)
count, total, avg = get_summary()
print(___, total, avg)
